youtube.title: Itsy Bitsy Spider 🕷️ Rain and Sun Weather Song for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing The Itsy Bitsy Spider with Robo and Itsy, the friendliest little spider! Itsy climbs up the water spout, the big green tree and a red umbrella. Down comes the rain and she slides down, wheee, then out comes the sun to dry it all up. Make rain with your fingers, guess sun or rain, shout up or down, and wait for the big surprise at the end: a rainbow!

What your child learns: the weather words rain, sun, cloud and rainbow, and the position words up and down.

Sing at home: wiggle your fingers down like rain, make a big round sun with your arms, and ask "Up or down?" every time the spider climbs. The first verse of The Itsy Bitsy Spider is a traditional public-domain rhyme sung to its traditional tune; the verses about the tree, the umbrella and the rainbow are original words written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Uh-oh! Rain!
Hee hee! Wet!
It's Itsy the spider! Sing with me!
Rain, sun, cloud... and a surprise!
A water spout! Will Itsy go up or down?
Up! Let's sing!
The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout.
Down came the rain and washed the spider out.
Wheee!
Out came the sun and dried up all the rain,
And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout again.
Your turn! Make rain with your fingers!
Wiggle, wiggle! Pitter, patter!
That's rain! Say rain!
Rain! Yay! Pitter, patter!
Itsy wants to climb the big green tree!
Look at the sky! Sun or rain?
A grey cloud... rain is coming!

scenes.title: Sing: up the big green tree

do.text: The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the big green tree.
Down came the rain, as wet as wet can be.
Wheee!
Out came the sun, so yellow and so round,
And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up, up, off the ground!
Make a big round sun with your arms! Say sun!
Sun!
Big and round! Yay!
Is Itsy going up or down? Watch!
Down! Down, down, down!
A red umbrella! Let's climb!
Look! What's that in the sky? A cloud! Say cloud!
Cloud!
Yes! A fluffy grey cloud!
The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the umbrella.
Then came a cloud, a fluffy cloud of grey.
Drip, drop, drip, drop, the spider slid away,
And the itsy bitsy spider stayed dry and warm today.
Where is Itsy? Under the umbrella!
I'm dry! Hee hee!
Bye-bye, cloud! Hello, sun!
Cloud!
One more time! Up the water spout!
The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout once more.
Down came the rain, and splash! Down to the floor!
Splash! Wheee!
What comes next? Sun or rain? Guess!
Three... two... one!
Out came the sun, a rainbow came out too,
And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up to see the view!
A rainbow! So many colours!
Say rainbow!
Rainbow! The surprise!
Rain, sun, cloud, rainbow!
Now a quick game!
Which one makes rain? Point to it!
Three... two... one!
Yes! The rain cloud! Pitter, patter!
Where is the rainbow? Point to it!
Three... two... one!
Yes! The rainbow!
Itsy goes up the spout! Up or down?
Up! Clever you!
Yay!
Everybody sing! Rain fingers ready!
The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout.
Down came the rain and washed the spider out.
Out came the sun and dried up all the rain,
And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout again.
Bye-bye, Itsy! Bye-bye, rain!
Bye-bye!
Bye-bye!
